=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:1311-1315 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test scans the entire model catalog for any slug sharing a provider prefix, so new same-family catalog entries that are not live reviewers will spuriously fail the contract test.
  WHY: pytest will fail on future catalog additions that match a provider prefix but are not live reviewers, breaking CI for unrelated catalog updates.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:1324-1348 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The test derives "mapped" status by scanning the entire model catalog for any slug sharing a provider prefix, then requires an explicit chain entry for every live REVIEWER_MODELS entry that has at least one alternate.
  WHY: Adding a new same-provider slug to the catalog, even if it is not used by reviewers, can fail CI even though the runtime failback logic only consults declared slugs for models that actually appear in REVIEWER_MODELS.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:165-178 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: _catalog_declared_model_slugs() does not filter catalog entries by supported_in_api, priority, or other usability flags, so unusable declared models can be treated as mapped candidates.
  WHY: A declared-but-unusable catalog entry could incorrectly flip a live reviewer into the "mapped" list, causing the test to demand a failback chain that the production reviewer_failback_target_for_model() path never exercises.
- scripts/reviewer_failback_chains.json:entire file | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The JSON file documents the mapped families but gives no schema, comments, or explicit list of intentionally unmapped families.
  WHY: Future maintainers extending the reviewer roster or catalog may leave a same-family reviewer unmapped and only discover it via REVIEWER_FAILBACK_UNMAPPED and the test, because the configuration file itself gives no guidance.
